title: populus balsamifera var. elongata
intro: Populus balsamifera var. elongata, commonly known as Black Cottonwood, is a variant of the Balsam Poplar tree native to North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various respiratory issues, such as bronchitis, coughs, and colds, due to its potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and acting as an expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Populus balsamifera var. elongata include its ability to reduce fever, relieve headaches, and soothe sore throats. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, as well as other flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
